units.source_text: 然而，我看到老师的洁白的下摆和洁白的布浓于在小树林的阴影中若隐若现，在黎明前的黑暗中远去的时候，

en.t: Yet when I saw the teacher's white hem and white cloth flickering in and out among the shadows of the grove, receding into the darkness before dawn,

units.source_text: 我的喉咙里燃烧着的力量，几乎变成难以控制的力量。

en.t: the force burning in my throat had almost become a force I could no longer control.

units.source_text: 我想把所有的一切都坦白出来。

en.t: I wanted to confess everything, every last thing.

units.source_text: 我想追上老师，拽住他的衣袖，逐一地大声陈述那雪天发生的事。

en.t: I wanted to catch up with the teacher, seize his sleeve, and loudly tell him one by one about everything that had happened on that snowy day.

units.source_text: 决不是对老师的尊敬才促使我如是想的。

en.t: It was certainly not respect for the teacher that made me think this way.

units.source_text: 而对我来说，老师的力量似是一种强有力的物理性的力量。

en.t: Rather, to me, the teacher's power seemed like a strong physical force.
